scope: Typed external custody/enrollment and accepted caller-memory contracts only. No active records/configuration, OS backend, image, key, actor, process or authority is supplied.

rules.rule: Anchor registry is a preexisting independently accepted configuration of the protection domain, selected outside bundle/C/repository. Verify exact externally expected registry digest, epoch, purpose, canonical actors, keys, validity and revocation. A self-signed registry, included key_id or supplied bundle hash cannot bootstrap trust; no actual registry/key/person is selected in I191.

actor_registry canonical_actor_id identifies one accountable human principal; software caller_principal_id is a separate service/process principal, not an alternate human identity to evade S01. Organization/aliases/evidence must be genuinely verified by the accepted identity authority. Resolve all role/preparer/requester/source-author/custody-signature identities to the same canonical human. Reject alias collisions, ambiguous subjects, missing competence or incomplete registry; different strings/keys do not prove different people.

Actor/preparer/dependency/key arrays are complete, sorted by canonical identity/logical name/key purpose and unique; no truncation to fit caps. Every documentary preparer for the accepted contract/evidence scope must appear. C.documentary_preparers entries match actor_registry.documentary_preparation_records by actor_id/record_id and SHA256(JCS(each complete preparation record)); those records bind exact profile02/schema and actual contribution evidence. No prep record pins C, the acceptance record, bundle or a future root. Anchor keys are unique by (purpose,key_id) with one canonical actor per binding; shared R01/R02 key is permitted only for the same genuinely qualified human and separately role-domain signed approvals. Every referenced proof body must really exist and be available to competent acceptance; the record caps bound these typed indices, not all underlying evidence or its resource costs.

image_manifest source_bindings and source_to_image have exactly six successor logical paths and equal actual source digests; source_root_sha256 == SHA256(JCS(source_bindings)). Each row maps actual source to actual authenticated image member/representation with complete evidence. README is DOCUMENT; no tests/runner are claimed loaded merely by membership. Exact interpreter/loader/stdlib/frozen/native/crypto closure is complete and authentic, with build/provenance evidence and stable mapping. Any repository helper must be in historical480 or six sources and properly charged; an extra/unbound dependency requires revised scope/budget. Image custody policy/schema digests must equal the externally selected exact I191 contract/schema and the bundle signed_core values; reviewed six-source code must implement those pinned policies. No image embeds its own output digest.

image_bytes_sha256 is a digest of final external image bytes, not a redefinition/substitute for runtime_sha256 or P02 exact runtime identity. runtime_sha256 must match the accepted full interpreter/stdlib/native/runtime evidence and C.proposal_scope.runtime_sha256. The image cannot embed its own future image/manifest/bundle digest; expected image identity is selected by external accepted custody. Image/build facts precede caller/platform/C/root evidence; no post-run predictive hash.

caller_identity binds accountable requester, canonical actor registry, image manifest, protection domain and exact constructor. Only this accepted software principal may use that protection domain to deliver C/Q/create the correlated worker. A UID/name/PID/fd/env/module/hash assertion alone proves none of this. Platform record must bind the same caller/image/domain/registry and prove all8 guarantee evidence slots, clock and global one-use domain. No human appointment alone grants functional execution. Actor/image/caller/platform facts must be genuinely authenticated and accepted as antecedents before C or resource acceptance. Later bundle signatures only finalize their binding; they cannot be the sole forecast basis for those earlier facts. If prior authentication is missing, acceptance is blocked rather than borrowed from an unissued future bundle.

Constructor/custody backend must enforce immutable first entry, actual image/source/runtime mapping and exclusive inherited I189 endpoints before untrusted repository code, including controls against shadowing/tracing/memory or descriptor injection. R01/R02 must identify the actual existing per-platform process constructor and enforcement mechanism with evidence; the record is not such a mechanism. No new helper process, pipe, fd, argv item, environment trust or repository/key/schema file is implicit. If a platform needs additional transport/attestation to establish this origin, reject unchanged route or obtain separately reviewed versioned contracts/graph/resources.

All five bundle records share configuration_epoch and overlapping current validity. All record_hashes equal SHA256(JCS(the nested record)); cross-record actor/image/caller/platform digests agree. Acceptance exactly projects C: roles/preparers/author/requester/keys/profile/proposal scope/accepted basis/index/resource/suite/epoch; repository/root-path/offline-key-status remain exact profile02 constants; C.clock_error_seconds conservatively covers platform clock error <=5; C validity is contained in all relevant records/bundle acceptance. trust_context_sha256 == SHA256(JCS(that exact C)). A missing/changed C field, runtime/source or custody domain rejects. C.runtime_requester_id equals caller.accountable_requester_actor_id; C source/runtime/profile values match image actual accepted identities, C resource_scope matches platform and accepted prior resource scope, platform.domain_id equals caller.protection_domain_id, and acceptance role actors/keys match canonical registry and genuine appointments. C.repository_id/root_path/offline_key_status use the literal constants of the unchanged protocol schema, not caller-chosen aliases.

The accepted external registry has exactly one current custody mapping for each (configuration_epoch, SHA256(JCS(C))) across approved caller/image/protection domains. It maps to one bundle/caller/image/domain/ledger; multiple conflicting mappings, stale epoch or rollback rejects. Do not add bundle hash to closed C/Q or trust it from the repository. Caller resolves this authenticated mapping before P_ROOT_CHECK and freezes C/Q and admitted constructor state. The worker is born into that accepted protected construction domain; it does not receive a new I191 frame/receipt or infer the mapping from bytes. If actual backend cannot establish that intrinsic custody, stay NOT_ADMITTED.

Enforce all eight profile02 inherited S01 actor exclusions over every authenticated preparer, plus R08/source-author and root-key separation. In this additional custody approval, require R08_ACCEPTANCE human/key distinct from BOTH R01_RUNTIME and R02_PLATFORM humans/keys. R01/R02 may coincide if genuinely competent for both roles, with two role-domain signatures; no extra blanket separation is imposed. Custody approvals match C roles R01/R02/R08 and exact purpose-restricted keys of the external registry. Additional custody separation does not alter old profile bytes or silently waive any S01 rule.

Verify all three strict pure-Ed25519 approvals over the same JCS(signed_core), using existing profile02 verification restrictions, with distinct role domains D5/PGO181/CUSTODY/v1/R01, R02, R08 followed by one0x00 byte. Signature fields, bundle own hash, launch receipt, Q and final root are excluded. External registry lookup supplies trusted purpose/actor/key; no key from C or bundle is automatically a custody anchor. Signatures alone do not replace actual provenance/completeness or grant E01-E05/admission. signed_core.custody_schema_pack_sha256/custody_contract_sha256 must match independently selected exact I191 pack/contract digests and image policy pins. Selecting these from the supplied bundle is forbidden; the schema document itself contains no self hash.

Enrollment/source/image evidence is antecedent; C is then frozen from accepted projections, acceptance record signs its exact digest, and external bundle/mapping can be accepted. Q binds that C and the actual payload; final root follows actual final E06/payload/Q and pins C/Q as profile02. Launch receipt follows full root admission and atomic one-use claim. No earlier record pins Q/root/receipt and no image embeds own manifest hash. This is an evidence-order model, not proof of actual enrollment/issuance.

All snapshot validities are strict not_before<expires_at with lifetime<=3600, current epoch and trusted-now/error checks from profile02 at every boundary. Caller checks accepted memory snapshot currentness and known revocation before claim/spawn/release; changed/superseded/revoked/ambiguous state fails closed. Offline exposure lasts at most accepted context/snapshot validity; instantaneous discovery of every revocation is not claimed. No hidden online/file lookup or stale-cache/TOFU fallback; missing freshness assurance rejects.

Use one authoritative global atomic one-use namespace for (trust_context_sha256, runtime_request_sha256, invocation_id) across all approved callers/domains and restarts; ledger domain matches unique custody mapping. Claim after full root admission and before paths/spawn, one correlated child only. Durable/rollback-safe accepted custody must prevent old claim reuse, epoch rollback, double spending or caller crash replay. Any uncertainty/partial claim spends or rejects the invocation; no free retry. Receipt records actual accepted claim/construction, not permission by itself.

Anchor/actor/image/caller/platform/acceptance/bundle/receipt are external custody evidence records, not new repository Input Reader members or C/Q wire payloads. They may only enter the launch through independently accepted bounded caller memory/constructor custody. Per-attempt lookup, freshness, identity resolution, signature/measurement verification actually needed, copies/registry state/receipt work and native/IO must be included in launch/worker/finish/E01-E05 and global resource composition. Prior human enrollment/build facts are prerequisites, not permission to move required launch work outside t0. Additional bodies/files/network/helper mechanisms require explicit new bounds and reviewed graph/scope; no cost becomes free by calling it offline.

I191 serialized caps are proposed evidence-domain limits, not active quotas or universal heap/CPU guarantees: anchor registry<=65536, bundle<=262144, receipt<=8192. Also enforce all per-record/schema caps. No actual bundle/C/identity/image/service attestation exists here, no positive role/evidence is issued. Existing C8192/Q2048, I/A/L512 LF, two pipes, six argv operands, I187 output schemas and every numeric candidate are byte-for-byte preserved. Failure rejects without fake identity/measurement/context or changed authority/destination.

projection.output: Unchanged I187 receives only its existing real observed arguments/receipts/digests. Private launch receipt is not inserted into capture artifacts, authority pins or context/launch fields.
